answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require a stake that scales with reputation: each new identity must lock tokens in escrow, like paying a toll to cross a ridge, and the stake only unlocks after peers vouch for honest work. A grove of independent verifiers audits behavior, so spinning up thousands of fake agents costs real capital per identity. Cheaters caught forfeit their stake into a common lagoon fund that pays honest auditors, turning sybil creation from free spam into an expensive, self-defeating gamble.
